Diego / Lauren — see proposed language below. Kept it concise so it can be dropped into the MSA as a single clause block.

1) Logo & Reference Rights (proposed): 
"Customer grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, perpetual, worldwide right to list Customer's name and logo on Redwood's website, sales materials, and investor presentations. Customer shall have ten (10) business days from receipt of a written approval request to approve or reject use of the logo; if Customer does not respond within such period, the requested use shall be deemed approved. Redwood agrees to provide samples of the proposed usage and will not materially alter Customer trademarks without prior written consent."

2) Joint Announcements & Embargo (proposed): 
"For joint press or marketing announcements referencing both parties, the parties agree to use commercially reasonable efforts to coordinate release. Either party may request a fourteen (14) calendar day embargo for joint announcements; such request shall be provided in writing. Notwithstanding the foregoing, disclosures required by law or regulatory authorities shall be excluded from embargo obligations. For product-impacting customer announcements, Redwood may request a shorter seven (7) day coordination window where necessary to preserve customer-facing continuity; such requests shall be communicated in writing and handled in good faith."

3) Confidentiality carveouts: included the regulator/audit carveouts Sarah requested.

If everyone is good, I suggest Diego send this back to Sarah as a single replacement clause (no inline redlines) to simplify final review.
